args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 18%). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate down to 0.2%.
